message.reasoning_content: need to determine the crime(s). Facts: Person produced bean sprouts, added "AB" powder containing 6-羟基腺嘌呤? Actually says 6-芐基腺嘌呤 (maybe a toxic additive) and 4-氯苯氧乙酸钠 (a herbicide). These are non-food harmful substances. So it's production and sale of unsafe food. Under Chinese criminal law, offense is "生产、销售不符合安全标准的食品" (producing and selling food that does not meet safety standards). The rule says: When the facts describe the acquisition, processing, and sale of animal-derived products that are unsafe or of unknown origin, classify under food safety statutes. Here it's plant-derived (bean sprouts) but still unsafe. So classification: "生产、销售不符合安全标准的食品". Also possibly "非法添加有毒有害物质" which is covered under same article. The instruction: When listing crime name(s) between [罪名] and <eoa> tags, output only the statutory offense name without appending the character “罪”. So we should output "生产、销售不符合安全标准的食品".
